integrity: The Gaussian-to-volume reduction is proved uniformly over varying configurations using compact truncated-volume minima. The explicit three-dimensional coefficient is independently recomputed from the unit-inradius right equilateral triangular prism. Unpublished partial results mentioned by the motivating paper remain inaccessible and are recorded as an originality risk.
limitations: Leading-order small-threshold result only; no fixed-positive-threshold optimizer, convergence rate, or full asymptotic-minimizer classification is claimed. The five-face geometric optimum is used from modern literature reporting the classical theorem.
title: Small-threshold rank-constrained Gaussian maxima are governed by circumscribed-polytope volume
